description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'AbstractApiController' for API endpoints within the Goteo project. It includes methods for handling JSON responses, user session initialization, and a generic file upload process. The class is designed to be extended by concrete API controller classes.

classes.name: AbstractApiController
classes.description: An abstract base class for API controllers in Goteo, providing session management, view theme setting, and a generic file upload method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session user and admin status, and sets the view theme to JSON.

methods.name: genericFileUpload
methods.description: Handles file uploads from HTTP requests, processes images, and returns result details including success status and messages.
